name: freecad-mcp
readme_summary: This repository provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates FreeCAD with Claude Desktop, enabling users to control FreeCAD functionalities and generate 3D models through conversational AI.
key_features: Configuration for Claude Desktop (user and developer)
primary_use_case: To enable users to design and manipulate 3D models within FreeCAD using natural language commands processed by Claude AI.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot architect is sitting at a drafting table, holding a tablet displaying a complex 3D model of a mechanical part. The robot is gesturing towards a large, floating blueprint that is transforming from a simple 2D sketch into the detailed 3D model. Around the robot, subtle digital particles and glowing lines emanate from the tablet, representing the AI's instructions. In the background, a stylized, clean interface reminiscent of FreeCAD and Claude AI is visible. The overall scene is bright, modern, and conveys a sense of intuitive creation. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette.

name: dembrandt
description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
readme_summary: Dembrandt is a command-line tool that automatically extracts design system tokens (like colors, typography, and borders) from any website. It uses Playwright to drive a browser, allowing for reverse-engineering of design elements into structured data, usable for AI agents and CI/CD pipelines.
key_features: Extracts design system tokens (logo, colors, typography, borders, etc.) from websites.
One-command execution for design token extraction.
Supports AI agent integration (MCP) for tasks like color palette extraction.
Offers automatic drift tracking and snapshot comparison via a web app.
Provides a recipe library for pre-defined workflows.
primary_use_case: To automate the extraction of design system tokens from existing websites, enabling consistency, auditing, and integration with development workflows and AI tools.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, akin to a master watchmaker, meticulously disassembling a complex, ornate clockwork mechanism representing a website. Tiny, glowing gears and springs (representing colors, fonts, and borders) are being carefully placed into separate, labeled compartments of a sleek, modern toolbox. The artisan is focused, using specialized digital tools that emit faint code-like particles. In the background, a subtle UI displays extracted design tokens. The overall mood is one of precision and discovery, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing clarity and the transformation of a complex whole into organized, usable parts.

name: Voice-Clone-Studio
description: A Gradio-based web UI for voice cloning and voice design, powered by Qwen3-TTS & VibeVoice.  Can use Whisper or VibeVoice-ASR for automatic transcription.
readme_summary: Voice Clone Studio is a modular, Gradio-based web UI for advanced voice manipulation tasks. It integrates multiple state-of-the-art engines for voice cloning, voice conversion, multi-speaker conversation generation, and sound effect creation, offering a unified interface for various voice AI technologies.
key_features: Multi-model voice cloning with engines like Qwen3-TTS, VibeVoice, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, and Fish Speech
Automatic transcription support via Whisper, VibeVoice-ASR, and Qwen3-ASR
Multi-speaker conversation generation with Qwen or custom VibeVoice voices
Support for Fish Speech Expression Tags for fine-grained delivery control
Prompt Generation and Saving using llama.cpp and Ollama
Modular architecture allowing easy enabling/disabling of tools
Voice prompt caching for instant subsequent generations
Split by Paragraph generation with automatic naming
primary_use_case: To provide a unified and user-friendly web interface for performing a wide range of voice cloning, voice design, and multi-speaker conversation generation tasks by integrating multiple advanced AI voice engines.
cover_image_prompt: A master sound sculptor in a vibrant, futuristic studio, holding a glowing microphone that captures ambient sounds and transforms them into distinct, colorful voice waveforms. One waveform is being sculpted into a new, unique voice, while another is being used to create a dialogue between multiple distinct characters represented by floating, stylized heads. Subtle UI elements showing audio input/output and voice parameters are visible on holographic displays around the studio. The scene is bathed in a soft, ethereal light, with digital particles flowing from the microphone to the waveforms. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing creativity and technological innovation.

name: kvm
readme_summary: JetKVM is an open-source KVM over IP solution written in Go and TypeScript, designed for high-performance remote computer management. It offers ultra-low latency video and smooth input control, with optional cloud and networking integrations.
key_features: Free & Optional Remote Access via WebRTC
Open-source software written in Golang on Linux
primary_use_case: Remote management of computers, servers, and workstations, including tasks like OS installation, BIOS adjustments, and general remote control.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled puppeteer in a dimly lit control room, using intricate strings and levers to remotely control a complex, glowing robotic arm. The puppeteer's console displays a live video feed of the arm's actions and subtle UI elements showing keyboard and mouse inputs. The robotic arm is performing a delicate task on a server rack in the background, symbolizing precise remote computer management. Small, ethereal data streams connect the console to the arm. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style, with a focus on glowing technological elements and a clean, organized composition, evoking the 'JetKVM' name subtly on the console screen.

name: scanopy
readme_summary: Scanopy is a Rust-based tool that automatically generates up-to-date network documentation by scanning infrastructure. It provides multiple views of the network, including L2, L3, workloads, and applications, replacing static diagrams with a continuously maintained model.
key_features: Multiple documentation views (L2, L3, workloads, applications)
primary_use_case: To automatically generate and maintain accurate network documentation and visualization, eliminating the need for manual drawing and ensuring the documentation reflects the current state of the infrastructure.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent cartographer meticulously drawing a sprawling, intricate city map. However, instead of drawing by hand, the cartographer is using a magical, glowing scanner that projects the city's true, ever-changing layout onto the parchment in real-time. Tiny digital streams of data flow from various buildings and infrastructure elements towards the scanner, which then translates them into clear L2, L3, workload, and application layers on the map. The scene is set in a modern, organized studio with soft, ambient lighting. Subtle UI elements displaying network metrics and the 'Scanopy' logo are visible on a nearby screen. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing clarity and the dynamic nature of the documentation.

name: sandbox
description: All-in-One Sandbox for AI Agents that combines Browser, Shell, File, MCP and VSCode Server in a single Docker container.
readme_summary: AIO Sandbox is a Dockerized, all-in-one environment for AI agents, integrating browser, shell, file operations, VSCode Server, and MCP services into a single, unified platform. It simplifies development and execution by providing a consistent and secure workspace with seamless file sharing across different tools.
key_features: Combines Browser, Shell, File, MCP, and VSCode Server
Unified File System for seamless data access
Multiple Interfaces: VNC, VSCode, Jupyter, MCP
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, secure, and all-in-one execution environment for AI agents and developers, integrating various tools like browsers, shells, and IDEs within a single Docker container.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic workshop where a central, glowing console acts as a nexus. From this console, holographic streams of data flow out, transforming into distinct tools: a web browser window displaying a webpage, a command-line interface with code scrolling, a file explorer with organized documents, and a VSCode interface with code snippets. These streams converge and diverge seamlessly, illustrating the integration. Small, stylized icons representing AI agents are seen interacting with these tools. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and slightly abstract, with a color palette of blues, purples, and whites, emphasizing connectivity and efficiency. The repository name 'AIO Sandbox' is subtly integrated into the console's display.
